items: Clear an area and its runestone turns into a soundsystem at once: invite every one of its wild animals, or see them run off (its sleeping legend and the baby in its circle don't count). Its babies dance, a party witch flies in and its music plays.
The waves keep their schedule along the ley line. A wave that reaches an area you've already cleared just celebrates: nothing is enraged.
Every area is full of animals from the start, and the areas later on the route hold more. Nothing grows while you play any more.
The boot-up takes 30 seconds, not five minutes, and a wave comes every 3 minutes, not 5.
